draft_email.body:
Dear Biro Keuangan / Finance Office (synthetic),

I received a tuition payment offer and payment slips on 2026-10-20 that asks me to pay tuition or fees.
Before I take any action, please confirm whether this request comes from your office and which payment channel I must use.

Items that do not match your published procedure:
- Payee name: Rina Fiktiana. The payee name differs from every approved channel.
- Payee account: ******6543. The account is not an approved institution account.
- Payment method: domestic_transfer. Not an approved method: domestic_transfer. Registry: UKT is never paid to a personal bank account.
- Documented procedure: potongan. The message contradicts the documented payment procedure.
- Documented procedure: perwakilan Bank. The message contradicts the documented payment procedure.
- Slip TRX-SYN-0002: IDR 7500000.00. PAYMENT_UNCONFIRMED, next action REQUIRES_INSTITUTION_CHECK. No institution ledger record matches this slip. A slip is not proof of settlement. Ask the finance office through the registry contact.
- Slip TRX-SYN-0004: IDR 7500000.00. CONFLICT, next action CONTACT_BANK_AND_INSTITUTION. The destination account is not an approved institution account in the registry.
- Warning sign: short deadline ("hari ini").
- Warning sign: discount offer ("potongan").
- Warning sign: offer to handle the payment for me ("tanpa ribet").
- Warning sign: sender claims to be a bank agent ("perwakilan Bank").
- Warning sign: asks me to use a chat app or phone number ("1 phone number(s) in message").

I have not paid through the channel in this request. I will wait for your written confirmation.
I can share the original message through your official channel if you request it.

Reference: CEKBAO sandbox case case_e69ec73d6264fdf7

Kind regards,
[Your name and student reference, added by you]
